verdict.line: You lose if you throw autos into an up Riposte or let her land both Lunge charges clean; you win if you poke from max range, blind her engages to deny Duelist healing, and out-scale her kiting once Shiv and boots are online.

brief.thesis: Teemo out-ranges Fiora's gap close by 80 units (680 on Q/E vs 600 on Lunge), and Blinding Dart directly denies the on-hit damage that fuels her Duelist passive healing — but Riposte punishes any auto you throw while it's up, and her double-dash Lunge plus Burst of Speed let her close that range gap twice in a few seconds. That tension is why OP.GG measures Fiora with the lane and solo-kill edge even though the long-run head-to-head sits near even at 50.2% over 1208 games.

theirWindow.what: Her second free dash is coming within a couple of seconds at no mana cost — don't trade back until both charges are spent, or she sticks to you with Burst of Speed (E) move speed stacking on top.

yourWindow.what: She has no parry answer for 6-10s depending on rank — this is when Blinding Dart (Q) and free autos from Toxic Shot (E) are safe, since there's no reflected magic damage waiting for you.

powerCurve.note: Her Q dash range nearly matches your poke range
Toxic Shot stacks and Blinding Dart offset her sustain
Blade Waltz (R) adds burst you can't out-trade
Shiv and boots let you kite her dashes
Full poke build and traps outscale her duels

start.why: Run by 73.9% of players at 51.6% over 1160 games — the mana pool lets you spam Blinding Dart on every engage, and the extra potion sustain covers the fact that she can out-sustain you with Duelist if you're forced into melee range.

boots.why: 50.8% over 531 games, 35.5% pick — the magic penetration pushes your Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot poke damage, which matters more than mobility since you're already kiting with Move Quick (W).

core.why: First item in the dominant 51.5% path over 336 games — the on-hit proc adds burst to your poke autos and the movement speed helps you reset range after she closes with Lunge.
Second in the same build path — the damage-over-time scaling stacks with Toxic Shot to punish her for staying in range to auto you.
Caps the core path at 51.5% WR — cooldown reduction means more Noxious Traps (R) down to zone her engages and more Blinding Darts to shut down her trades.

situational.when: you are snowballing and want the cooldown reset on traps and Blinding Dart sooner (this reorder hits 60.5% over 86 games)
she's building health and you need the extra burn-adjacent execute damage to close out trades (54.2% over 59 games)
her Duelist stacks are healing her back up in extended fights — OP.GG's own read on this lane is to buy anti-healing first
she keeps sticking to you off Burst of Speed (E) move speed stacks and you need the extra kiting speed over raw penetration

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing consecutive autos while you kite — since Toxic Shot has no cooldown, poking from max range builds the stacks naturally and the bonus damage plus vulnerability window punishes her for closing distance.

summoners.why: 92.9% pick rate at 51.1% WR — Ignite directly counters her Duelist sustain in early skirmishes by burning through the healing, and Flash answers her double-dash Lunge engage when you need to disengage immediately.

playing.title: Max range on every poke
playing.detail: Stand at 680 range and auto/Q from outside her 600-range Lunge — she has to eat windup and walking time to reach you, which is a free trade she can't return in kind.

playing.title: Blind the engage, not just the poke
playing.detail: Save Blinding Dart (Q, 8s cooldown) for when she commits with Lunge rather than firing it on cooldown — blinding her mid-engage denies the on-hit damage that triggers Duelist healing, not just chip poke damage.

playing.title: Never auto into an up Riposte
playing.detail: If her W is available, a free auto risks eating the parry's reflected magic damage — wait for its 6-10s cooldown to drop or bait it out before committing your own trade.

playing.title: Kite with Move Quick after her dashes
playing.detail: Once she spends both Lunge charges, she has no gap close until it resets (16s down to 8s by rank) — use Move Quick's (W) building speed to walk back to max range immediately.

playing.title: Respect Blade Waltz from level 6
playing.detail: Her R lets her dash around hitting champions with diminishing damage per repeat hit — keep minion or ward buffers in skirmishes so she can't path onto you for free burst.

playing.title: Pre-lay traps before trades
playing.detail: Noxious Trap (R) is only a 1s cooldown — drop mushrooms in the brush or path she'll dash through so her engage eats a slow and damage tick before she ever reaches you.

playing.title: Buy into her healing, not just her damage
playing.detail: OP.GG's own tip for this matchup is to prioritize healing reduction — if Duelist stacks are topping her off in extended trades, move Oblivion Orb up earlier than planned.

brief.patchCaveat: Every item, rune, boots, and summoner pairing above comes from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the win rates, pick rates, and sample sizes are real. The tactical reasoning — why the range gap matters, when to blind, when Riposte punishes you — is my own read on the ability interactions, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Fiora’s Riposte(W) reduces attack speed and movement speed to its targets. Avoid it while applying pressure! Purchase items that reduce healing first!
